activities.title: Introduce yourself
activities.objective: Introduce yourself using basic personal and professional information.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 30 to 60 seconds.
activities.task: Say your name, your job, what you teach or work with, and one thing you enjoy doing.
activities.objectiveEs: Preséntate usando información personal y profesional básica.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 30 a 60 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Di tu nombre, tu trabajo, qué enseñas o con qué trabajas y una cosa que disfrutas hacer.

activities.title: Talk about your family
activities.objective: Talk about close family members using simple connected sentences.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Talk about two family members. Say who they are, what they usually do, and one thing they like.
activities.objectiveEs: Habla sobre familiares cercanos usando oraciones sencillas conectadas.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Habla sobre dos familiares. Di quiénes son, qué hacen normalmente y una cosa que les gusta.

activities.title: Describe your daily routine
activities.objective: Describe a normal weekday using simple present sentences and time expressions.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Describe a normal weekday. Say when you get up, what you do during the day, and what you usually do in the evening.
activities.objectiveEs: Describe un día normal entre semana usando oraciones en presente simple y expresiones de tiempo.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Describe un día normal entre semana. Di a qué hora te levantas, qué haces durante el día y qué haces normalmente en la noche.

activities.title: Talk about likes and dislikes
activities.objective: Talk about personal likes and dislikes and give simple reasons.
activities.instructions: Speak in English for 45 to 90 seconds.
activities.task: Talk about three things you like and two things you dislike. Give a simple reason for at least two of them.
activities.titleEs: Habla sobre lo que te gusta y lo que no te gusta
activities.objectiveEs: Habla sobre tus gustos y disgustos personales y da razones sencillas.
activities.instructionsEs: Habla en inglés durante 45 a 90 segundos.
activities.taskEs: Habla sobre tres cosas que te gustan y dos que no te gustan. Da una razón sencilla para al menos dos de ellas.
